situations.title: 출혈 초기 사정
situations.tagline: I cut my hand and it won't stop bleeding.
situations.brief: 출혈량·부위·박동성을 사정해 심각도를 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: How long has it been bleeding and how much have you lost?
Is the blood steady or does it spurt with your pulse?
Let me look at the wound and apply pressure.

situations.title: 직접압박 지혈 설명
situations.tagline: Should I be pressing on it this hard?
situations.brief: 지속 직접압박과 거상으로 지혈하는 방법을 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: Press firmly and steadily right on the wound.
Keep your hand raised above your heart.
Don't keep lifting the gauze to check—hold the pressure.

situations.title: 상처 세척·평가
situations.tagline: There's still dirt in the cut from when I fell.
situations.brief: 이물·깊이·오염도를 확인하며 상처를 세척·평가하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll rinse the wound to remove dirt and debris.
I'm checking how deep it is and if anything is inside.
Tell me if you feel anything still stuck in there.

situations.title: 파상풍 예방 문진
situations.tagline: I honestly don't remember my last tetanus shot.
situations.brief: 접종력을 문진해 파상풍 예방 필요성을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: When was your last tetanus shot, even roughly?
This type of wound may need a booster to be safe.
We'll give the vaccine now if you're not up to date.
goals: 상처 유형에 따른 예방 필요성을 판단한다

situations.title: 통증·기전 청취
situations.tagline: A rusty piece of metal sliced my leg.
situations.brief: 수상 도구·오염원 등 기전과 통증을 청취하세요.
keyPhrases: What caused the cut and was the object dirty or rusty?
On a scale of zero to ten, how bad is the pain?
When did this happen?

situations.title: 열상 봉합 준비 교육
situations.tagline: Are you going to stitch this up? Will it hurt?
situations.brief: 국소마취와 봉합 후 관리를 환자에게 교육하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll numb the area first so the stitches don't hurt.
Keep the wound clean and dry after we close it.
You'll come back to have the stitches removed.
goals: 봉합 후 관리와 발사 일정을 교육한다

situations.title: 항응고제 지속출혈
situations.tagline: I'm on warfarin and it just keeps oozing.
situations.brief: 항응고제로 지혈이 지연되는 환자의 역전·검사를 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Which blood thinner do you take and when was your last dose?
We'll check your clotting labs to guide treatment.
We may give medicine to help your blood clot.

situations.title: 동물 교상 감염관리
situations.tagline: A stray dog bit my arm—should I worry about rabies?
situations.brief: 세척·광견병·항생제로 동물 교상의 감염을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll clean the bite thoroughly to lower infection risk.
Do you know if the dog was vaccinated?
You may need rabies prevention and antibiotics.
goals: 상처를 충분히 세척하고 감염 위험을 사정한다

situations.title: 사람 교상 특수관리
situations.tagline: I got bitten during a fight—it's on my knuckle.
situations.brief: 감염 위험이 높은 사람 교상을 봉합 지연과 함께 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Human bites carry a high risk of infection.
We often leave these wounds open rather than stitch them.
You'll need antibiotics and close follow-up.
goals: 사람 교상의 높은 감염 위험을 사정한다

situations.title: 이물 잔존 창상
situations.tagline: I think there's still a piece of glass in there.
situations.brief: 영상으로 이물을 확인하고 무리한 제거를 피하도록 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll get an X-ray to see if glass is still inside.
We won't dig blindly, to avoid causing more damage.
Please keep the area still until we image it.
goals: 잔존 이물 가능성을 사정하고 영상을 조율한다

situations.title: 정맥성 다량출혈 지혈
situations.tagline: The blood is flowing steadily and it's a lot.
situations.brief: 압박·거상·드레싱으로 정맥성 다량출혈을 지혈하세요.
keyPhrases: This is steady venous bleeding, so we'll press and elevate.
I'm applying a firm pressure dressing now.
Keep the limb raised to slow the flow.

situations.title: 두피 열상 다량출혈
situations.tagline: My head is bleeding so much—it's all over.
situations.brief: 혈관이 풍부한 두피 열상을 압박으로 지혈하세요.
keyPhrases: Scalp wounds bleed a lot because of rich blood supply.
I'm pressing firmly on the wound edges to stop it.
The heavy bleeding looks worse than it usually is.
goals: 창상 깊이와 두개 손상 동반 여부를 사정한다

situations.title: 만성 상처(당뇨족) 감염
situations.tagline: This sore on my foot smells bad and won't heal.
situations.brief: 괴사·냄새·전신 징후로 당뇨족 만성 상처 감염을 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm checking the wound for dead tissue and infection.
Do you have a fever or feel generally unwell?
How is your blood sugar been controlled lately?
goals: 발열 등 전신 감염 징후를 확인한다

situations.title: 언어장벽 창상
situations.tagline: 开水... 割伤... 我不会说英语。
situations.brief: 언어장벽 환자의 기전·접종력·알레르기를 통역과 함께 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm getting an interpreter to help us understand each other.
How did the wound happen, and with what object?
Are you allergic to any medicines, and is your tetanus current?

situations.title: 항혈소판제 병용 출혈
situations.tagline: I take aspirin and clopidogrel—it keeps bleeding through.
situations.brief: 항혈소판제 병용으로 지혈이 지연되는 상황을 통합적으로 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Taking two blood thinners makes bleeding harder to stop.
Which antiplatelet medicines do you take and when?
We'll apply firm pressure longer and monitor closely.

situations.title: 동맥성 분출 지혈대
situations.tagline: It's spurting out with every heartbeat—help!
situations.brief: 압박 실패한 동맥성 분출에 지혈대를 적용하고 적용 시각을 기록하세요.
keyPhrases: This is arterial bleeding, so we're applying a tourniquet.
I'm noting the exact time the tourniquet went on.
It will be tight and painful, but it will save your limb.

situations.title: 실혈성 쇼크 급속진행
situations.tagline: I feel freezing and everything is going gray.
situations.brief: 저혈압·창백을 사정하고 수혈·수술을 신속히 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: You've lost a lot of blood, so we're giving you a transfusion.
Your pressure is very low, so we're acting fast.
We're preparing you for surgery to stop the bleeding.

situations.title: 경부 창상 기도·혈관 위기
situations.tagline: My neck is bleeding and it's getting hard to breathe.
situations.brief: 경부 창상의 혈종·기도 압박 위기를 인지하고 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: A neck wound can swell and press on your airway.
We're controlling the bleeding and protecting your airway.
Tell me right away if breathing gets harder.

situations.title: 절단부 대량출혈
situations.tagline: My hand was cut off and it's bleeding everywhere.
situations.brief: 지혈대로 절단부를 지혈하고 절단부 보존·재접합 이송을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: We're placing a tourniquet to stop the bleeding now.
We'll preserve the amputated part cool and moist.
The surgical team is being called for possible reattachment.

situations.title: 위장관 대량출혈 토혈
situations.tagline: I keep vomiting blood and I feel so weak.
situations.brief: 토혈 환자의 흡인 위험을 관리하고 내시경 이송을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll position you to protect your airway from the blood.
You're bleeding internally, so we're giving fluids and blood.
The GI team will do a scope to find and stop the bleeding.

situations.title: 출혈 SBAR 인계
situations.tagline: Surgery wants a handoff—give me the report.
situations.brief: 실혈량·지혈·수혈 상태를 SBAR로 정확히 인계하세요.
keyPhrases: This is a 36-year-old with heavy arterial limb bleeding.
A tourniquet was applied at 14:20 and bleeding is controlled.
We've given two units of blood and pressure is improving.
